works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 亮橙底上多部手机斜着排开，中间地图标着“22 bikes available in your area”，右侧 Trek E-MTB 车型详情配 93% 电量与 Unlock Bike 按钮；租车 App 用“一块橙色 + 一张地图 + 一个解锁按钮”把找车、看车、开锁三步压进一屏。
works.comment_en: E-Bike Rental App tilts several phones across a bright orange backdrop: a map in the middle reads “22 bikes available in your area,” while a Trek E-MTB card shows 93% battery and an Unlock Bike button; one orange field, one map and one unlock button compress finding, checking and unlocking a bike into a single screen.
works.title: E-Bike Rental App

works.author: Artspire
works.comment: 深蓝底上并排多部 iPhone，Fodmappa 的症状进度 28% FODMAP、12 天连续打卡、膳食清单一字排开，底部 Ask Coach 的 AI 对话栏随时待命；营养 App 用“一个进度条 + 一条打卡链 + 一个 AI 入口”把症状追踪做得像日常习惯。
works.comment_en: AI Nutrition puts several iPhones side by side on deep blue: Fodmappa's symptom progress at 28% FODMAP, a 12-day streak and a meal list in a row, with an Ask Coach AI chat bar waiting at the bottom; one progress bar, one streak and one AI entry turn symptom tracking into a daily habit.
works.title: AI Nutrition Mobile App & Symptom Tracking

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa for Korsa
works.comment: 阳光洒在木桌上，笔记本屏幕里是米色 Halden 房地产着陆页，左边一句“Wow, dream home! … Finally home!”，右边客厅照片配棕色 Sustainable 卡片；房产落地页用“一台电脑 + 一句感叹 + 一张客厅照”把买房的憧憬讲得温暖可信。
works.comment_en: Halden's real estate landing page sits on a laptop in warm sunlight: “Wow, dream home! … Finally home!” on the left, a living-room photo and a brown Sustainable card on the right; one laptop, one exclamation and one living-room shot make the dream of buying a home feel warm and believable.
works.title: Halden - Real Estate Landing Page Animation

works.author: tubik
works.comment: 黑色深色着陆页，顶部 Factura 导航配橙色 Request beta 按钮，中央“Join the Factura beta”大字加邮箱输入框，底部立体岩石 3D 元素托底；SaaS 内测页用“一个大标题 + 一个输入框 + 一块 3D 岩石”把冷峻与号召力捏在一起。
works.comment_en: Dark SaaS Landing Page 3D sets a black page with Factura navigation and an orange Request beta button, “Join the Factura beta” in huge type over an email field, and chunky 3D rocks anchoring the bottom; one headline, one input and one slab of 3D rock pack a beta invite with both chill and urgency.
works.title: Dark SaaS Landing Page 3D

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 浅蓝底上并排三部手机：开屏“Take care. Feel good.”配红色爱心气球，中间“Your care, all in one place.”待办预约列表，右侧 New appointment 医生选择界面；挂号 App 用“三屏走完开屏、待办、约医生”把就医流程讲得清清爽爽。
works.comment_en: Health App lines up three phones on pale blue: an opening screen reading “Take care. Feel good.” with a red heart balloon, a “Your care, all in one place.” appointment to-do list, and a New appointment doctor picker; three screens walk from welcome to booking a doctor, keeping the whole care journey light and clear.
works.title: Health App - Doctor Appointment Booking

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 灰色底左侧蓝色手机界面，大字“Automated Genomics Molecular Biology”，右侧粉色移液管的实验室机器人设备，标注 8.1x 更有效与 96.22% 更准确；生物科技站用“一部手机 + 一台机器人 + 两个数字”把实验室自动化讲得硬核又直观。
works.comment_en: ordivalabs pairs a blue phone screen reading “Automated Genomics Molecular Biology” with a lab robot holding a pink pipette, stamped 8.1x more effective and 96.22% more accurate; one phone, one robot and two numbers make lab automation feel both hard-core and instantly legible.
works.title: ordivalabs: Biotechnology & Robotics Website UI/UX - Mobile

works.author: Vlad Bahatskyi for VALMAX
works.comment: 深色制造业软件着陆页，左侧黄紫色块写着“Full traceability across materials, molds, machines”与 1,284 批次、99.7% Traced，右侧紫色立体褶皱 3D 图形配“Every batch tracked”大标题；工业软件页用“两个数字 + 一块 3D 褶皱”把全程追溯讲得扎实有分量。
works.comment_en: Polyq's manufacturing software landing page runs on dark tones: yellow and purple blocks on the left read “Full traceability across materials, molds, machines” with 1,284 batches and 99.7% Traced, while a purple pleated 3D form carries the headline “Every batch tracked”; two numbers and one folded 3D shape give full traceability real weight.
works.title: Landing Page Design for Manufacturing Software — Polyq
